title: One finished project against five finished tutorials

videos.script: Five finished tutorials look like more work than one project. They usually are. And they prove less. {{five}} A tutorial proves you can follow instructions. That is worth something, and everybody applying for the same job can prove it too, often with the same tutorial, down to the variable names. {{same}} What a tutorial cannot prove is everything the author decided for you. What to build, what to leave out, what to do when it broke in a way the video did not show. {{decided}} So this lesson defines finished. Then it shows one commit from loanbook that no tutorial contains, and what to do with the tutorials you already have.
